about_the_game:
SPELLCAST is a fusion of card battlers and word games. Construct your deck with runes and bonuses, then play words on a grid to use them in battle. The power of your spells changes based on the words and letters you play, making each turn a delicate balance of wizardry and wordplay.

Grow more powerful by optimizing your runes and bonuses, collecting artifacts, and upgrading your tiles. Runes also have multiple upgrades that can enhance or greatly change their effects, for a wide variety of deckbuilding possibilities.

Battle your way through 10 unique scenarios, or play the campaign for a more traditional roguelite experience, while aiming for high scores and ranks. You can earn better scores by playing more efficiently, or get a higher ranking by tackling challenging bounties along the way. See how high you can go!
